selection_rule: Choose highest dev Evidence Hit@3, then highest dev Hit@1, then fewer chunks. If still tied, prefer B, then A, then C.
filter_policy: Only C applies the question's supplied filter. A and B ignore filters. C uses no filter when absent.
test_policy: Finalize configurations and select a strategy on dev before running test. Report test for all strategies without tuning against test results.
split_method: Manual split: dev q01-q15, test q16-q20. Both splits cover both chapters. Related concepts may overlap, so topic leakage is a limitation.
ai_assistance: Questions and code drafted with AI assistance; evidence checked against extracted text. Student must verify answer support against the PDF.
hash_update_reason: Reconfirmed current benchmark before any retrieval experiment.
